dedupe_keys.name: base de donnees nationale des mouvements de terrain

description: Base de Données Nationale des Mouvements de Terrain is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.brgm.fr. The BDMVT database lists the proven phenomena of landslides, landslides, collapses, mudslides and bank erosions on French territory (metropolis and DOM) as part of the prevention of natural hazards implemented since 1981. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "National Database of Field Movements" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Glissements, Cartographie, Eboulements, Coulées, Effondrements, Risques naturels. The listing shows 2007-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
